empty: No diagrams yet — start a flowchart or an ER diagram.

discard.title: Discard unsaved changes?
discard.description: Changes to “{title}” have not been saved.

delete.title: Delete this diagram?
delete.description: “{title}” will be removed for the whole team.

hint: Drag a shape from the left bar or click it to add · drag from a dot on a shape's edge to connect · select a shape, then click its text to edit (or double-click) · Delete removes · ⌘/Ctrl + C, X, V copy / cut / paste, D duplicates, A selects all, Z undoes

ai.description: The company AI drafts the diagram from your instruction and what the request says about this project. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

placeholder.flowchart: e.g. Leave request flow: the employee submits, the supervisor approves or rejects, HR records it
placeholder.er: e.g. Tables for leave requests: employees, leave types, requests and approvals

revise.flowchart: Revise the flowchart already on the canvas
revise.er: Revise the ER tables already on the canvas

ai.done: AI draft ready — review it, then save
ai.off: AI is not set up on this server
ai.failed: The AI could not draft the diagram
ai.placedBeside: Everything else on the canvas stays; a new draft is placed to the right of it.

snapOn: Snap to grid: off — click to turn on
snapOff: Snap to grid: on — click to turn off

sql.exportHint: CREATE TABLE statements for the ER tables on this diagram (MySQL). Foreign keys come from the relationship lines.
sql.importHint: Paste CREATE TABLE statements (MySQL). Tables, columns, primary and foreign keys become ER tables on the canvas.
sql.replace: Replace the ER tables already on the canvas
